associationClusters.association: African swine fever reduced hog supply and raised the probability of a sustained pork shortage. Follow the demand substitution into poultry only where company supply and pricing can convert, while distinguishing ASF demand support from an already-existing white-feather-chicken supply cycle.

Commercial 5G licensing arrived earlier than many market participants expected. Follow the acceleration into components whose prior revenue contribution was small but production technology/customer qualification was already ready for batch deployment.

Trade-war escalation turned rare earths into a strategic leverage narrative. Map physical price/export effects separately from speculative equity repricing; reject if listed expressions are already driven primarily by narrative rather than new company earnings.

Tariffs and technology restrictions increased incentives to shift or duplicate supply chains. Search for company-specific localization/import-substitution order pools, but do not infer a generic domestic-substitution long.
March industrial output and Q1 growth beat expectations after a weak February. Treat as macro context unless company orders/backlog provide an incremental bridge.
Targeted stimulus and credit support may change funding conditions, but only direct financing-sensitive earnings/FCF changes qualify.
Trade-war escalation moved the yuan and commodity-demand expectations. Search for direct FX/input-cost incidence rather than broad market-beta trades.
